description: This PHP source file implements a database driver class for DB2 via ODBC, extending the ODBC driver class. It provides methods for database interaction, metadata retrieval, SQL query generation, and connection management specific to DB2 databases.

classes.name: ADODB_ODBC_DB2
classes.description: Driver class for handling DB2 databases over ODBC, extending the generic ODBC driver class with DB2-specific implementations.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_odbc_db2
classes.description: Record set class for managing result sets from DB2 via ODBC, including metadata type mapping.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version and description info about the connected DB2 ODBC driver.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Generates SQL expression to handle null values using COALESCE.

methods.name: RowLock
methods.description: Locks a row in the table based on the specified condition.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names from the database, filtered by type and schema.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Fetches index information for a specified table.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Constructs SQL expressions for date formatting based on given formats.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Performs a SQL query with limit and offset for pagination.
